headline: Earnings Upgrades Put Twilio Stock In Focus
summary: Twilio was added to the S&P 500 Equal Weighted Index and removed from two Russell small cap composite indices in early October 2026, reflecting a shift in how the business is classified across benchmark universes. The index changes arrive alongside increasingly optimistic earnings estimates and broadly positive brokerage research, which together focus attention on Twilio’s ability to convert higher-value customer engagement demand into sustained profitability.
